text: Gender: F. Examination result. Clinical diagnosis (suspicion) Cancer of the cardia. Date of admission: Material: 1) Material: stomach, Method of collection: Total organ resection. Final reult: Stomach adenocarcinoma (G3, pT2, pNO). (8140/3 T-63000). codes according to ICD-O-3 or SNOMED. Macroscopic description: Specimen consisting of the stomach, having been incised along the greater curvature, sized 28.6 x 27.9 cm, with. omentum sized 52 X 18 cm and spleen sized 12.2 x 5.8 x 3.9 cm. In the omentum, spleen with additional diameter of 1 cm and pieces of pancreas sized: 4x 1, 5x2 cm. Tumour sized 12.8 X 11.7 x 2.9 cm in the cardia region on the back wall. Distance from the proximal end: 0.4 cm, from distal end: 23 cm. Microscopic description: Gastric adenocarcinoma (papillary, partially solid type with some mucous cells (mixed type acc. to Lauren class). Cancer infiltrated the whole thickness of the stomach wall and fat tissue of the omentum. Excision lines, omentum and lymph nodes (17) - free of neoplastic lesions. Spleen and pancreas free of neoplastic lesions.

T.evidence: Final reult: Stomach adenocarcinoma (G3, pT2, pNO).
T.reason: The report explicitly states pT2, but the microscopic description ('Cancer infiltrated the whole thickness of the stomach wall and fat tissue of the omentum.') suggests deeper invasion (through serosa/into adjacent fat), which is inconsistent with pT2.

N.evidence: Final reult: Stomach adenocarcinoma (G3, pT2, pNO).
N.reason: Report gives pN0 and notes 'Excision lines, omentum and lymph nodes (17) - free of neoplastic lesions.'

M.evidence: Spleen and pancreas free of neoplastic lesions.
M.reason: No pathologic M status is explicitly stated. Resected organs (spleen, pancreas) and sampled tissues showed no metastases, but absence of distant metastasis cannot be fully excluded from the report alone.

T.reason: Report explicitly states pT2, but the microscopic description ('Cancer infiltrated the whole thickness of the stomach wall and fat tissue of the omentum') could suggest deeper/serosal/adjacent organ involvement inconsistent with pT2.

N.evidence: lymph nodes (17) - free of neoplastic lesions.

M.reason: Report does not state distant metastasis (no pM status); wording about omentum involvement is contradictory and does not clearly document distant metastatic disease.

T.evidence: Final reult: Stomach adenocarcinoma (G3, pT2, pNO).
T.reason: The report explicitly lists pT2. However, the microscopic description states the cancer "infiltrated the whole thickness of the stomach wall and fat tissue of the omentum," which could suggest a higher T category; I followed the pathologist's recorded pT2 despite this internal inconsistency.

N.evidence: Final reult: Stomach adenocarcinoma (G3, pT2, pNO).
N.reason: The report gives pNO and documents 17 lymph nodes as free of neoplastic lesions.

M.evidence: Spleen and pancreas free of neoplastic lesions.
M.reason: No distant metastases are reported and sampled organs (spleen, pancreas) are negative. There is no explicit pM statement and the report contains some internal contradictions about omental involvement, so confidence is not high.
Report does not state pathologic or clinical M (distant metastasis) status.
